requirement.description: The with_suffix method has incorrect handling of raw_parts for URLs with paths starting with slash. The implementation produces an extra empty string in raw_parts when processing URLs like "/a" that should result in raw_parts of ("/", "a.b") but instead produces ("/", "", "a.b").
requirement.contract: The with_suffix method should correctly reconstruct raw_parts for absolute paths starting with slash. When a URL like "/a" has ".b" appended as suffix, the resulting raw_parts should be ("/", "a.b") with no empty string in the middle.

requirement.description: The raw_parts property incorrectly handles absolute URLs with empty paths. When a URL like "/" is processed, it should return ("/",) but the current implementation may produce incorrect results for certain edge cases.
requirement.contract: The raw_parts property must correctly return path components for absolute URLs. For URLs with paths like "/" or "/path", the raw_parts should properly reflect the path structure without introducing unexpected empty elements.

requirement.description: The raw_name property doesn't correctly handle the case where the URL path starts with a slash. This affects how the suffix replacement logic determines what part of the path to modify.
requirement.contract: The raw_name property must correctly extract the last component of the path, regardless of whether the path starts with a slash. For URL "/a", raw_name should be "a", not an empty string.
